name: EvilEye
identity: Floating gold spherical single-eyed monster with two ochre bat wings, one huge ivory front eye and small curved mouth; rear has no eye. No legs or tail.
individual_constraints: One bright ochre gold spherical shell with ONE large ivory eye at front only; no mouth, teeth, legs or tail
Exactly two simple ochre triangular leathery wings with two inner membrane regions
Rear shell has no eye or face, original small dark gold spots retained
Head cells contain the entire spherical shell only, NO wings. Body cell is a small plain gold opaque connector hidden within shell
